title: Håstad tester
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\delta\in[0,1]$. Define a tester whose random seed has the Håstad seed distribution with parameter $\delta$; on seed $(x,y,b,z)$, its check uses the predicate that accepts three signs exactly when their product is $b$, and queries the vectors $x,y,z$ in that order.
